# Bridgetown AI

> Portland, Oregon-based AI company that designs and deploys 24/7 AI employees for small businesses.

## What We Do

Bridgetown AI builds autonomous AI employees for digital jobs: email, calendar, CRM, research, documents, outreach, ops, and more. Agents connect to real tools. A human can stay in the loop at every stage. Irreversible actions require approval.

## Offer

- Free discovery call (30 minutes): map one AI-employee role, tools, and human checkpoints.
- Promise: no customer is ever charged until they agree their AI employee is providing the value being charged for.
- Builds and ongoing care are scoped after discovery.

## Example roles AI employees handle reliably

Inbox triage & drafting · Calendar & scheduling · Meeting prep & follow-up · Spreadsheet & report ops · Research · Document drafting · Outreach sequences · CRM hygiene · Order/vendor chase · Support triage · Knowledge base curation · Monitoring & alerts

## Key Differentiators

- Free discovery with zero pitch tax
- Human-in-the-loop by default
- Value-before-invoice risk reversal
- Real system connections, not chat toys
- On-prem / private options when data must stay close

## Stacks we work with

Hermes · OpenClaw · Paperclip · ChatGPT · Claude · Grok · Grok Bot · Muse · Jev

## Location

Portland, Oregon (Portland metro and remote-ok)
